# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Keep all project-specific agent notes, procedures, plans, decisions, and working documentation inside the repository, under `docs/agents/`. Do not leave their only copy in chat, temporary tool storage, an Agent Store, or a VM. Follow [working procedures](../docs/agents/working-procedures.md) and update the [agent index](../docs/agents/README.md) for new documents.
- For sprite-to-3D assets, prioritize recognizable object anatomy, faithful source colors, and the intended material (e.g., squirrel-shaped hedge/topiary). Small details not visible in the original low-resolution sprites may be added to better express the object's original intent. Silhouette overlap metrics alone are not visual approval; the squirrel-shaped tree must read as a squirrel-shaped hedge/topiary.
